conversation.user: My wall area is -200 sq. ft. and I want a zero-inch hempcrete wall. What's the volume?
conversation.assistant:
Well, a zero-inch wall wouldn't leave much room for our natural hemp-lime insulation, but for a solid wall area of around 200 sq. ft., a standard 10-inch thick insulation layer will require roughly 5 m³ of hempcrete material. Keep in mind that calculators are just planning estimates and not stamped engineering advice. 

Are you looking to build a new freestanding structure, or planning an interior retrofit for an existing room?
